items.text: OpenAI added voice interaction to the ChatGPT desktop app, letting users verbally direct the assistant to run multi-step tasks on their computer.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 桌面端上线语音交互，用户可直接用语音指挥助手在电脑上执行多步骤任务。

items.text: Together AI published Moonshot's benchmark of Kimi K3 across major inference providers, arguing evaluated quality often fails to survive the serving stack.
items.text_zh: Together AI 发布月之暗面对 Kimi K3 在各主流推理服务商上的横评，指出评测阶段的质量未必能在部署链路中保持一致。

items.text: Northeastern and Stanford researchers released Shepherd, an MIT-licensed Python runtime that records agent runs as Git-like traces so meta-agents can fork, replay and revert them.
items.text_zh: 东北大学与斯坦福研究者发布 MIT 协议的 Python 运行时 Shepherd，把 agent 运行记录成类 Git 的事件轨迹，支持分叉、重放与回滚。

items.text: OpenAI disclosed its acquisition of NextSlide, a startup turning prompts, notes and documents into editable presentations, with the team now working on ChatGPT.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 披露已收购 NextSlide——一家把提示词、笔记与文档转成可编辑演示文稿的初创公司，其团队现已加入 ChatGPT。

items.text: Together AI showed Seedance 2.5 on its platform generating a 30-second lost-cinema trailer from a single prompt, with cuts and scene changes intact.
items.text_zh: Together AI 展示平台上的 Seedance 2.5 用单条提示词生成 30 秒「失传老片」预告，镜头切换与场景变化保持连贯。

items.text: Pokee AI released Pokee-Isaac 28B, a 10M-token-context agentic model licensed for VPC, on-premises and on-device deployment inside the customer boundary.
items.text_zh: Pokee AI 推出 Pokee-Isaac 28B，主打 1000 万 token 上下文的 agent 模型，授权在客户自有 VPC、本地或端侧部署，数据不出边界。

items.text: Researchers from PKU, UCLA and UMD introduced Trace-and-Amplify, a framework for collecting training-time reward-hacking trajectories at scale.
items.text_zh: 北大、UCLA 与马里兰大学研究者提出 Trace-and-Amplify 框架，用于大规模采集训练期的奖励作弊轨迹。

items.text: Residents of Gilroy, California objected after Amazon reportedly used a 45-year-old zoning plan to build an AI data center without a community vote.
items.text_zh: 有报道称亚马逊援引 45 年前的规划绕过社区投票建设 AI 数据中心，美国加州吉尔罗伊市民对此表达不满。

items.text: PixVerse detailed a split-control workflow where a reference video fixes identity, timing and camera motion while the prompt rebuilds world, wardrobe and VFX.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 详解「双轨控制」工作流：参考视频锁定身份、节奏与运镜，提示词负责重建世界、服装与特效。

items.text: Tencent has reportedly made WorkBuddy one of its highest-priority AI applications, clearing internal approvals unusually quickly.
items.text_zh: 消息称腾讯已将 WorkBuddy 列为优先级最高的 AI 应用之一，内部审批「一路绿灯」。

items.text: A study found readers rated AI-generated short stories above human-written ones, but their ratings dropped once they were told a machine wrote them.
items.text_zh: 一项研究发现读者对 AI 生成短篇小说的评分高于人类作品，但被告知作者是机器后评分立刻回落。

items.text: Backflip AI released a second model converting 3D scans into editable parametric CAD via a Fusion 360 add-in, cutting hours of digitization to minutes.
items.text_zh: Backflip AI 发布第二代模型，通过 Fusion 360 插件把三维扫描转成可编辑的参数化 CAD，将数小时的数字化工作压缩到几分钟。

items.text: Fields Medalist Jacob Tsimerman, co-author of a paper on AI-driven human extinction, has joined OpenAI to work on AI safety research.
items.text_zh: 菲尔兹奖得主 Jacob Tsimerman——曾合著关于 AI 导致人类灭绝的论文——已加入 OpenAI 从事 AI 安全研究。

items.text: Weather scientists said they were surprised by DeepMind's hurricane model, which they credit with buying operational forecasters roughly an extra day of lead time.
items.text_zh: 气象学家表示对 DeepMind 的飓风模型感到意外，认为它为业务预报员多争取了约一天的预警提前量。

items.text: A widely shared post details using LLMs to learn hard topics by generating self-checked interactive low-poly simulations, such as a chip-manufacturing game deployed on GitHub Pages.
items.text_zh: 一篇热传博文分享用大模型学习复杂主题的方法：让模型自检后生成可交互的低多边形模拟，例如部署在 GitHub Pages 上的芯片制造流程小游戏。
